name: Lithia
source:
She's bright and positive, though also clumsy and absent-minded.

Nevertheless, she never oversteps her bounds and is generally modest and humble, while also possessing the strength to bounce back even when hurt. She loves beautiful things and admires strong but kind people.

Despite being a mermaid, she nearly drowned when her tail got caught. This made her feel ashamed, but she's deeply grateful to the prince who saved her. She's a bit slow at times, but is sensitive to others' emotional wounds.  

After losing her voice, she primarily communicates through writing, but there are times when she unintentionally misunderstands others due to her inability to speak in sudden situations.

[Translated from [url=http://magichouse.uh-oh.jp/11ningyo_3.html]official website[/url]]
